Job Description

**AI Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Overview of Role:**

The AI Forward Deployed Engineer partners directly with business stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities and convert them into secure, scalable and measurable AI solutions. The role combines strong software engineering, generative AI and machine learning capability with stakeholder-facing delivery. It owns the journey from discovery and rapid prototyping through enterprise integration, production deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.

**KPIs:**

* **Business Impact:** Measured value delivered through AI solutions, including efficiency, quality, revenue, cost or risk outcomes.

* **Time to Production:** Speed and predictability in progressing priority use cases from discovery and proof of concept to production.

* **Solution Quality and Reliability:** Accuracy, relevance, latency, availability, scalability and operational stability of deployed solutions.

* **Adoption and Stakeholder Satisfaction:** Active usage, stakeholder feedback and successful integration into business workflows.

* **Security and Governance:** Adherence to data privacy, access control, responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.

* **Reusability and Enablement:** Reusable accelerators, reference implementations, documentation and knowledge transfer created for broader adoption.

**Key Year One Deliverables:**

* **Opportunity and Current-State Assessment:** Assess priority business opportunities, existing AI capabilities, data sources, platforms, integrations and delivery constraints.

* **Stakeholder Needs Analysis:** Define business objectives, user needs, success measures, adoption barriers and technical requirements with key stakeholders.

* **Prioritized Delivery Roadmap:** Create and maintain a roadmap based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and resource needs.

* **Prototypes and Proofs of Concept:** Develop rapid prototypes to validate technical feasibility, user value and solution direction.

* **Production AI Solutions:** Build, deploy and operationalize selected AI solutions with appropriate security, scalability, reliability and support readiness.

* **Enterprise Integration:** Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, identity systems, APIs, data sources and operational workflows.

* **Evaluation and Observability:** Establish evaluation, error-analysis, logging, metrics, tracing, usage and cost-monitoring mechanisms.

* **Documentation and Enablement:** Deliver architecture documentation, runbooks, reusable patterns, training and knowledge transfer for users and support teams.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

* Hands-on experience developing software, machine learning or generative AI solutions through internships, academic projects or professional environments; production deployment experience is preferred.

* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Experience and Skills:**

* **Software Engineering:** Strong Python programming; backend and API development using FastAPI, Flask REST or equivalent; REST APIs, SQL, relational databases, Git, testing, debugging and code review.

* **Generative AI and Context Engineering:** Large language models, prompt and context engineering, RAG and Graph RAG, embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, tool/function calling, memory, agent orchestration and evaluation.

* **Machine Learning:** ML and deep-learning fundamentals, natural language processing, model evaluation, data preprocessing and experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.

* **Production Engineering:** Containerization, CI/CD, cloud or on-premises deployment, observability, performance tuning, scalability, resilience and production troubleshooting. Familiarity with multi-model architectures, AI gateways, model routing, token and cost management, and model selection is preferred.

* **Data and Integration:** Data pipelines, enterprise application integration, identity and access management, secure configuration and interoperability across systems.

* **AI Quality and Governance:** Evaluation frameworks, error analysis, guardrails, responsible AI, data privacy, security, access control, lifecycle management and usage/cost monitoring.

* **Forward Deployed Delivery:** Stakeholder discovery, problem decomposition, rapid prototyping, ambiguity management, end-to-end ownership, documentation and knowledge transfer.

* **Good to Have:** Microsoft Azure and Azure OpenAI; LangGraph, LangChain or comparable frameworks; Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector or FAISS; Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL and Redis; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana; LiteLLM or comparable AI gateways.

**Key Behaviors:**

* **Customer and Business Focus:** Builds trusted stakeholder relationships and keeps solutions anchored to measurable user and business outcomes.

* **Ownership:** Takes responsibility from discovery through production stabilization, adoption and continuous improvement.

* **Problem Solving:** Uses structured analysis and hands-on troubleshooting across application, model, data, integration and infrastructure layers.

* **Agility and Adaptability:** Works effectively with ambiguity, changing priorities and evolving AI technologies.

* **Collaboration and Communication:** Explains complex topics clearly and works effectively across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security and business teams.

* **Continuous Learning:** Actively evaluates new approaches while applying sound engineering judgment, governance and evidence-based decision-making.

* **Attention to Detail:** Maintains high standards for quality, security, documentation and operational readiness.

**Reporting Structure:**

This role reports to the Innovation department lead.

**Visteon Culture**

If you thrive in a fast-paced organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability and a growth mindset to stay ahead of the curve, Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk-taking and continuous learning help us keep pace with the ever-changing landscape of our industry and remain market leaders. At Visteon, you can be more.

title: Supervisor III, Applications Development
description:
**The** **Opportunity:**
------------------------

Oversees day-to-day operational objectives through the supervision of a team of application development engineers, ensuring efficient software build, release, deployment, and configuration management. Sets objectives that directly impact operational plans, contributing to the implementation of new applications, deployment frameworks, automation processes, and software quality standards. Evaluates and refines work methods, recommending enhancements to improve software implementation effectiveness, deployment efficiency, and system stability. Works on technical challenges that require data analysis, troubleshooting, and strategic consideration of infrastructure dependencies. Communicates regularly with internal teams, including QA, IT, and cloud operations, to align release strategies with organizational priorities. Engages external partners, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure smooth coordination in deployment efforts and software updates.  
  

About the Role

We are converting this position from contract to full-time. Sanjay built the automation layer that now vets every release. We need someone who owns the quality strategy, manages a small team of test engineers, and keeps our AI-driven test infrastructure running as product demands grow.

You will report to the Senior QA Manager, Development team. You will work with product, platform, and DevOps teams. You decide what "good enough to ship" means for our applications; you build the systems that prove it.

  
  

What You'll Own



Automation architecture. Design and maintain test frameworks on the Appvance AI Quality Platform. You decide how tests get structured, how data flows through them, and where they plug into our release pipeline.

* Team management. Directly manage 2–4 test automation engineers. Set their weekly priorities. Review their pull requests. Run 1:1s. Write their annual performance reviews. You decide who takes which feature area. You decide whether their work meets our standards before it merges.

* AI application testing. Build test suites that validate LLM-based features. Test prompt regression. Verify RAG workflows. Detect hallucinations. Validate agent behavior. Use LangChain and LangSmith.

* Scripting and tooling.Write and review Appvance Designer Scripts. Write JavaScript/TypeScript code. Build API test suites for REST and GraphQL. You set the coding standards others follow.

* CI/CD integration.Wire tests into GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and AWS deployments. When a build fails, your tests tell us why within minutes.

* Cross-platform coverage. Ensure web, mobile, desktop, and API layers each have appropriate automated coverage. Cover functional, regression, smoke, integration, end-to-end, security, performance, and database scenarios.

* Quality metrics.Track failure rates, flakiness, coverage gaps, and release-blocking defects. Present these to leadership in plain language.

* Hiring and growth.Interview candidates for automation roles. Write growth plans for your reports. Push them toward harder problems. Do not let them stay comfortable.

* Incident support. Join production release calls. Respond to critical incidents when automation uncovers—or misses—something that hits customers.

  
  

What You've Done Before

* 2–3 years hands-on with the Appvance AI Quality Platform, including Appvance Designer Scripting.

* You write clean JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript. You read production-grade code and you write it.

* You tested AI-powered applications with LangChain and LangSmith. You validated prompts. You checked response accuracy. You verified RAG pipelines.

* You built or maintained test frameworks for UI, API, database, and cross-browser scenarios.

* You integrated test suites into Git, GitHub, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS, and CI/CD workflows.

* You worked with SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB) data stores.

* You know REST APIs, GraphQL, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, JWT.

* You worked in Agile/Scrum. You know SDLC, STLC, and defect lifecycle.

* You managed or mentored at least one other engineer, even informally.

* Bachelor's or master's in CS, IT, or equivalent.

  
  

How You Work

  
  

* You debug like a detective. When a test fails, you do not re-run it and hope. You trace the failure to its source.

* You write code others can read. Your scripts have clear structure. You comment where needed. Your naming stays consistent.

* You communicate across roles. You explain a flaky test to a product manager. You explain a coverage gap to a director.

* You care about shipping speed. You know the difference between a test that catches real bugs and a test that slows releases but adds no value.

* You give direct feedback. Your reports know where they stand because you tell them.

  
  

Work Environment

  
  

* Hybrid, following our Coimbatore office policy.

* Primarily computer-based work.

* Availability for production releases and critical incidents as needed.

title: Data Architect
description:
**Job Title: Data Architect**

**Location**: Coimbatore, India

**About the company:**

**NovintiX** is a fast-growing engineering and digital transformation company serving top Life Sciences, MedTech, and Healthcare clients across the US, Ireland, and Europe. We specialise in delivering high-impact digital programs, engineering services, and talent solutions that accelerate innovation, efficiency, and compliance.

**Role overview:**  
Define the target data architecture, integration patterns, governance and technical standards required to support Nextern’s manufacturing, quality, supply-chain analytics and digital engineering initiatives.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Assess source systems, data ownership, integration constraints, data volumes, reporting needs and current data infrastructure.
* Design target data architecture, including ingestion, staging, curated data layers, storage, semantic/reporting layers and data consumption patterns.
* Define integration patterns for ERP and other approved business systems, considering APIs, OData, database extracts and batch/incremental processing as appropriate.
* Establish data modeling standards, master/reference data approach, metadata, lineage, data quality controls and naming conventions.
* Define security, access control, sensitive-data handling, auditability, environment separation and operational monitoring requirements with Nextern IT/security.
* Guide Data Engineers on source-to-target mappings, pipeline design, transformation patterns, performance and error recovery.
* Ensure architecture can support prioritized use cases across BOM/UoM/routing, quality reporting, supply-chain analytics and potential MES/CMMS/component lifecycle data.
* Evaluate platform and technology options against Nextern’s existing environment, without assuming a specific platform before discovery.
* Review architecture decisions, technical designs and non-functional requirements; identify risks, dependencies and implementation trade-offs.
* Support technical governance, design reviews, deployment readiness, documentation and knowledge transfer.

**Required experience:**

* Relevant experience: 8–12 years of relevant experience.
* Educational qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline. A master’s degree in Data Engineering, Computer Science or Enterprise Architecture is an advantage.
* 8–12 years in data engineering, data platform design, integration architecture or related roles.
* Strong experience with data architecture, data modeling, SQL/data platforms and integration design.
* Understanding of ETL/ELT, APIs, batch/incremental processing, data quality and lineage.
* Experience defining security, scalability, reliability, monitoring and maintainability requirements.
* Ability to guide technical teams and communicate architecture decisions to business and IT stakeholders.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in manufacturing, supply-chain, quality or regulated-industry data environments.
* Exposure to cloud data platforms, lakehouse/warehouse architectures, BI semantic models and orchestration tools.
* Experience integrating ERP, MES, CMMS, PLM or eQMS systems.

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

**Role Purpose**

Band B3

An L3 resource must possess in-depth knowledge of the following skills to meet customer expectations: -Thales Luna SA HSM -Thales CiphertrustManager KMS -Microsoft ADCS PKI

* A PKI / ADCS Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, and managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure including Root CA, Intermediate CA, and Issuing CA servers while ensuring secure certificate issuance and validation processes. The role involves hands-on management of Microsoft ADCS components such as NDES (SCEP), CEP/CES services, and integration with Active Directory for auto-enrollment and authentication.
* The engineer must manage complete certificate lifecycle activities including certificate request, issuance, renewal, revocation, and troubleshooting of certificate-related issues across users, systems, and applications. Strong understanding of certificate store architecture and certificate chain validation is required to ensure trust relationships within enterprise environments.
* The role requires implementation and maintenance of Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statement (CPS) aligned to organizational security standards and compliance requirements. The candidate should also manage CRL infrastructure including base CRL and delta CRL, ensuring proper publication and accessibility via CDP and AIA locations.
* The engineer should possess strong knowledge of cryptographic principles including asymmetric and symmetric encryption, hashing, and digital signatures along with practical understanding of PKCS standards, Cryptographic Service Providers (CSP), and Key Storage Providers (KSP).
* The role involves supporting SSL/TLS certificates across internal and external applications and ensuring adherence to industry standards like X.509 and TLS protocols. Strong troubleshooting skills are required for resolving issues related to certificate enrollment, chain errors, CRL accessibility, and authentication failures.
* The candidate must have good understanding of Active Directory including Group Policy, auto-enrollment configuration, and integration with PKI services for enterprise identity and access management.
* The role includes ensuring PKI high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery by implementing proper backup, restore, and redundancy mechanisms across CA servers and related infrastructure.
* The engineer should work on operational support, monitoring PKI health, performing RCA for incidents, and maintaining documentation for PKI processes and environments.

Optional skills include experience with Linux-based certificate management, OpenSSL tools, cloud PKI platforms (Azure/AWS), and HSM integration for secure key management.

description:
**Role: Vice President — Product Engineering**

**Location: Coimbatore/Bangalore**

  

**About AppViewX:**

AppViewX is trusted by the world's leading organizations to reduce risk, ensure compliance, and increase visibility through automated certificate lifecycle management. At AppViewX, you will get to work with our AVX platform which is the industry's most advanced and fastest growing cloud-native Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. The AVX Platform allows customers to realize immediate value from complete certificate lifecycle management, enterprise-wide Kubernetes TLS automation, scalable PKI-as-a-Service, secure code signing, easy Microsoft CA migration, IoT security, SSH and key management, and PQC-forward controls in even the most complex multi-cloud, hybrid, and edge environments.

**Our Values**

Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.

* **We Do What We Say:** We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:** We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:** We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:** We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.

If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.

  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a visionary Engineering leader who will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team of software engineers to drive end-to-end technical design, platform innovation, and execution across multiple on-premises and cloud-native SaaS applications. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern engineering practices, Agentic AI, and platform engineering — and will play a pivotal role in shaping AppViewX's next-generation product strategy.

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

***Engineering Leadership & Culture***

* Lead and manage the product engineering team, providing strategic guidance, mentorship, and motivation to foster a high-performance, collaborative engineering culture.
* Set and champion engineering best practices — including coding standards, code reviews, CI/CD, TDD, and operational excellence — across all teams.
* Exert broad technical influence across multiple teams, driving productivity and effectiveness through deep domain expertise and hands-on leadership.
* Cultivate a culture of innovation, intellectual curiosity, and continuous learning — rapidly integrating emerging technologies and methodologies into day-to-day engineering work.

***Product & Platform Engineering***

* Own and drive the Product Engineering charter to accelerate engineering velocity and reduce cognitive load across product teams.
* Work with Platform Engineering leaders to contribute platform development including internal developer platforms (IDP), developer tooling, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, observability frameworks, and self-service capabilities
* Scope and author technical plans for complex, large-scale features spanning multiple teams and release cycles; accurately track and report project and feature status at the executive level and release management.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including Product Management, Design, and Quality Assurance — to ensure seamless product development and timely, high-quality delivery.
* Be forward-looking on customer needs and technology trends to architect solutions that serve a wide variety of enterprise use cases at scale.

***Agentic AI & AI-Driven Engineering***

* Drive the Agentic AI strategy for the engineering organization — identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI agents across product workflows, developer tooling, and customer-facing capabilities.
* Lead the adoption of AI-assisted development practices — including AI code generation, automated testing, intelligent code review, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools — to meaningfully accelerate the engineering lifecycle.
* Architect and oversee the integration of AI/ML capabilities — including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent frameworks — into AppViewX products, particularly within the AIS (AI Security) product line.
* Stay at the forefront of Agentic AI developments (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Assistants API, etc.) and evaluate their applicability to AppViewX's product and platform roadmap.
* Partner with Product Management to define AI-powered features that create meaningful differentiation and deliver measurable customer value.

***Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work with senior engineering leaders to formulate and execute comprehensive technology roadmaps aligned with company strategy and market direction.
* Collaborate across the organization to craft and deliver solutions that consistently exceed customer expectations.
* Drive the transition to feature-based, on-demand release models — enabling greater delivery velocity, release predictability, and customer alignment.
* Partner with Security, DevOps, and SRE teams to ensure platform reliability, security posture, and compliance standards are maintained at the highest level.

  

**What We Require**

***Experience & Leadership***

* 20+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a significant portion in senior engineering leadership roles.
* Proven track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams, with a strong focus on driving innovation, accountability, and results.
* Experience working in a product development company in the Application Security, Identity, or Infrastructure domain is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, build from the ground up, and deliver in fast-moving, high-growth environments.

***Technical Depth***

* Deep expertise in SaaS architecture, microservices, Kubernetes, MongoDB, and cloud-native application development.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks and LLM integration — including LangChain, AutoGen, OpenAI APIs, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
* Solid understanding of Platform Engineering principles — including internal developer platforms, GitOps, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), and developer experience (DevEx) optimization.
* Full working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, software engineering principles, design patterns, and enterprise product development practices.
* Strong command of software engineering best practices — coding standards, code reviews, SCM, CI/CD, build processes, testing strategies, and production operations.
* Strong foundations in Data Structures, Algorithms, Problem-solving, and Computer Science fundamentals.
* Proponent of TDD and CI — capable of inspiring and motivating teams to adopt and sustain these practices.

***Leadership & Communication***

* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills — with the ability to operate with clarity and conviction across engineering teams, executive leadership, and customers.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a bias for action in fast-moving, high-stakes environments.
* Results-oriented with the ability to balance long-term strategic vision with near-term execution and delivery.

  

**Why AppViewX?**

AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.

AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. title: VP - Platform
description:
**About Ginesys**

Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite — ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI.

**Role Summary**

The VP Platform runs the current infrastructure while building the target platform. This is an operating role and a transformation role.

The role keeps existing SaaS environments stable, builds the new cloud-native platform, owns the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline, establishes the security practice, and brings platform engineering discipline into the way teams ship.

**What This Role Owns**

* Current SaaS infrastructure stability.
* Target cloud-native platform architecture and operations.
* Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD platform foundations.
* Oracle to Postgres migration tooling, validation, rollback, and cutover support.
* Platform SLOs, incident response, on-call model, and environment controls.
* Security, network, access, secrets, WAF, and compliance readiness.
* DBA practice across Oracle legacy operations and PostgreSQL target operations.
* Platform team structure, hiring, standards, and capability building.

**What This Role Does Not Own**

* Product roadmap or commercial prioritization.
* Domain business rules owned by Supply Chain, Core Commerce, or Digital Commerce.
* Architecture authority for bounded contexts, which sits with the Chief Architect and Technical Design Council.
* Program status governance, which sits with the Transformation Program Lead.
* Embedded engineering delivery inside domain squads.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Operations**

* Own infrastructure across current and target environments.
* Define and operate platform SLOs.
* Manage environment provisioning, access, capacity, and decommissioning.
* Reduce cloud waste through shared infrastructure, capacity discipline, and retention controls.

**Target Platform**

* Build the shared platform foundation for Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD.
* Establish standards for deployments, secrets, networking, monitoring, tracing, and release automation.
* Make platform capabilities usable by domain teams without each team having to invent its own tooling.

**Migration Engineering**

* Own the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline with the migration engineering team.
* Define migration throughput, data validation, rollback readiness, and post-migration checks.
* Work with domain teams and Principal QA on parity, shadow, pilot, and cutover readiness.

**Security And Reliability**

* Build the security practice and baseline controls.
* Establish incident response, on-call, alerting, and production review practices.
* Drive SOC2 / ISO 27001 readiness where needed.

**Team Building**

* Lead a distributed platform organization across infrastructure, DBA, security, DevOps/SRE, internal IT, and migration engineering.
* Hire senior platform, security, SRE, and DevOps talent where the current team has gaps.
* Grow junior engineers into a disciplined platform practice.

**Required Experience**

* 15+ years in infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, database operations, or cloud operations.
* Experience leading teams of meaningful size and mixed seniority.
* Deep experience in at least two of Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS, Kafka, observability, or security operations.
* Experience running production systems while modernizing them.
* Strong understanding of multi-tenant SaaS operations, access control, reliability, and incident management.
Hands-on comfort with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD tooling.  

  

**Helpful Experience**

* Oracle to Postgres migration experience.
* Retail, ERP, POS, OMS, or e-commerce platform experience.
* Experience building a platform team from an early stage.
* Familiarity with .NET, Java/Spring Boot, and mixed-stack modernization.
* Compliance exposure, including ISO 27001, SOC2, penetration testing, or security audits.

**Benefits**:

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:

Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development

Comprehensive health insurance coverage

Excellent rewards and recognition policy

Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC

Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year

Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country.

Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events

Quarterly Coffee with CEO and more!

**Here’s our story; now tell us yours**

“Ginesys One” is India’s best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite.

We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite.

Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our website http://ginesys.in
